data.one_liner: Frame-driven, lifecycle-aware marquee widget with unified speed control and interaction support.
data.what_it_does: Provides smooth automatic scrolling of looping text or widgets in a marquee format. It supports click and drag interactions, adjustable speeds, and lifecycle-aware autoplay pause and resume.
use_when: You need to display scrolling text or banner items in an infinite loop.
You require custom item builders and separators for marquee elements.
avoid_when: You are building full games or physics simulations where general-purpose game engines are more appropriate.
strengths: Frame-driven scrolling with Ticker for smooth motion across refresh rates.
Lifecycle-aware autoplay pause/resume and built-in drag interaction.
Unified speed API measured in logical pixels per second.
weaknesses: Limited to marquee and ticker-style scrolling use cases.
